استعملا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْمَلَا (istaʕmalā) /is.taʕ.ma.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# اُسْتُعْمِلَا (ustuʕmilā) /us.tuʕ.mi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# اِسْتَعْمِلَا (istaʕmilā) /is.taʕ.mi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
